name: [🌋UPD] Fish On
desc:
🎣 Fish On! - Fun & Addictive Fishing Adventure!

Welcome to Fish On!, a relaxing fishing game full of surprises and fun!
Cast your line, catch cute fish up to rare ones, and collect them all to become the number one fisherman!

🐟 What can you do?

🔹 Fishing at various exciting spots - from peaceful ponds to colorful open seas
🔹 Luck increases every second! - the longer you play, the greater your chance of catching super rare fish
🔹 Display your fish collection - let all players see how cool your catches are
🔹 Upgrade your fishing gear - so big fish won't escape anymore
🔹 Discover hundreds of different fish—from cute and strange to super rare
🔹 Relaxing yet addictive - perfect for chilling, grinding, or just having fun with friends
